senses.gloss: קַלֵּס ch. same, to call out; to praise; to tramp.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 6:9">Targ. Esth. VI, 9</cite>; <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 6:11">11</cite> (h. text <he>קרא</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Deuteronomy 32:43">Targ. Y. II, Deut. XXXII, 43</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Exodus 32:18">Targ. Y. II, Ex. XXXII, 18</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 21b:1">Keth. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>משום דקַלְּסָהּ … את נמי מְקַלְּסַת לה</he> because thy mother’s father commended it, thou commendest it likewise.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 8:1:6">Y. Kil. VIII, 31ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>והוה … מְקַלֵּס ליה הזלים וכ׳</he> R. J. praised him by applying the verse (<cite ref="Isaiah 46:6">Is. XLVI, 6</cite>) &c. Y. Maas. Sh. I, end, 53ᵃ <he>אמרה … וקַלְּסֵיה</he> he said it before R. Abina, and he applauded him, opp. <he>קנתריה</he>; a. e.—Y. Peah I, 15d; Y. Ab. Zar. I, 42ᶜ top <he>מקלס קומי וכ׳</he> did honor to bridal couples (singing, dancing &c.); (<cite ref="Ketubot 17a:5">Keth. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>מרקד</he>).
